title: MQ Stack Repo Contract
description: Declares a repo's participation in the MQ stack contract gate.

schema.description: Optional schema identifier for pointer-style repo contracts.

role.description: Role this repo plays in the MQ stack.

version.description: Must match the VERSION file in the repo root.

canonical_contract.description: Optional repo-relative path to the canonical contract.

release_mode.description: How release changes are allowed to reach the default branch.

compatibility.description: Optional: machine-readable compatibility boundary consumed by the stack compatibility gate (mq.stack-compatibility.v1). Absent metadata is reported as missing and never blocks; present metadata that contradicts pyproject.toml is inconsistent and does block.

protocols.description: Protocol tracks this repo is written against, e.g. {"mcp_api": "1.x-fastmcp"}. The leading major identifies the track.

dependencies.description: Declared compatibility boundary per dependency, as a PEP 440 specifier. Must agree with the range declared in pyproject.toml.

produces.description: MQ contracts this repo produces, e.g. 'mq-mcp.tools.v1'.

consumes.description: MQ contracts this repo consumes, e.g. 'mq.feedback.v1'.
